Shim washers: Shims adjust the slide for proper clearance. If the slide is adjusted too tightly against the tool, it may not lock during rotation. If adjusted too loosely, tools will rock or fall out during rotation.
Adjuster rod: Locks the slide in place during a tool change.

Plunger: Locks the adjuster rod during arm motion. The adjuster rod and slide cannot release the tool when the plunger is in the extended position.

chunks.text:
Side-Mount Tool Changer - Manual Recovery - Mill

Introduction
This procedure tells you how to perform a manual recovery on the Side-Mount Tool Changer (SMTC) of a Haas mill. A recovery is required if the SMTC cannot complete a tool change.

VMC - HMC - Side-Mount Tool Changer - Manual Recovery

1. Push [RESET] to clear any alarms. Push [RECOVER]. The control attempts an automatic recovery. Push [A].

2. If the automatic recovery attempt is not successful, the control gives you the (M) Manual recovery option. Push [M] for Manual.

3. The display shows suggestions to correct the problem. Follow the prompts as they are displayed. Use these commands to move the tool changer components: Push [ATC FWD] or [ATC REV] to turn the double arm. Push the [UP] or [DOWN] cursor arrows to raise or lower the tool pocket. Push [ORIENT SPINDLE] to reset the spindle orientation and lock it. Push the [LEFT] or [RIGHT] cursor arrows to turn the carousel left or right. Push the [TOOL RELEASE] button to trigger the tool clamp/unclamp.

4. If you push [ORIENT

chunks.text:
it. Push the [LEFT] or [RIGHT] cursor arrows to turn the carousel left or right. Push the [TOOL RELEASE] button to trigger the tool clamp/unclamp.

4. If you push [ORIENT SPINDLE], the display shows a warning dialog box. Push [N] to cancel the spindle orientation if the tool changer double arm will interfere with the spindle when the spindle orients. If the spindle can safely be rotated and locked, push [O].

5. After the problem has been corrected, the display shows that no further actions are required. Push [C] to continue.

6. The Pocket Tool Table on the control displays the pocket that is currently in front of the spindle and the tool that is in the spindle. Make sure that the tool in the spindle and the current pocket match the control's display.

7. Push [MDI]. Push [ATC/FWD] to test the recovery. If the tool change recovery is not successful, it is most likely that the machine is mechanically jammed. Contact your Haas Factory Outlet for assistance.

question: Tóm tắt cấu trúc quy trình khôi phục sau alarm 2066 trong nguồn: các nhánh tự động, thủ công, xác nhận hoàn tất và kiểm tra thông tin dao liên hệ với nhau thế nào?

response.answer:
Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Nhấn [RESET] để xóa mọi alarm và nhấn [RECOVER] để điều khiển thử nghiệm khôi phục tự động, sau đó nhấn [A].

Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Nếu quá trình khôi phục tự động không thành công, điều khiển sẽ cung cấp tùy chọn khôi phục thủ công (M) và người dùng nhấn [M] để chọn thủ công.

Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Màn hình hiển thị các gợi ý và yêu cầu làm theo các thông báo được hiển thị, sử dụng các lệnh như [ATC FWD]/[ATC REV] để quay tay đôi, các phím mũi tên [UP]/[DOWN] để nâng hoặc hạ túi dao, [ORIENT SPINDLE] để đặt lại và khóa định hướng trục chính, các phím mũi tên [LEFT]/[RIGHT] để quay băng chứa dao, và [TOOL RELEASE] để kích hoạt kẹp/nhả dao.

Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Nếu nhấn [ORIENT SPINDLE], màn hình hiển thị hộp thoại cảnh báo: nhấn [N] để hủy nếu tay đôi gây cản trở trục chính khi định hướng, hoặc nhấn [O] nếu có thể quay và khóa an toàn.

Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Sau khi sự cố được khắc phục, màn hình hiển thị không cần thực hiện thêm hành động nào và nhấn [C] để tiếp tục.

Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Bảng Pocket Tool Table trên điều khiển hiển thị túi hiện đang ở trước trục chính và dụng cụ trong trục chính, đảm bảo công cụ trong trục chính và túi hiện tại khớp với màn hình của bộ điều khiển.

Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Nhấn [MDI] và nhấn [ATC/FWD] để kiểm tra lại quá trình khôi phục.

Màn hình hiển thị các gợi ý và yêu cầu làm theo các thông báo được hiển thị, sử dụng các lệnh như [ATC FWD]/[ATC REV] để quay tay đôi, các phím mũi tên [UP]/[DOWN] để nâng hoặc hạ túi dao, [ORIENT SPINDLE] để đặt lại và khóa định hướng trục chính, các phím mũi tên [LEFT]/[RIGHT] để quay băng chứa dao, và [TOOL RELEASE] để kích hoạt kẹp/nhả dao.
Nếu nhấn [ORIENT SPINDLE], màn hình hiển thị hộp thoại cảnh báo: nhấn [N] để hủy nếu tay đôi gây cản trở trục chính khi định hướng, hoặc nhấn [O] nếu có thể quay và khóa an toàn.
Sau khi sự cố được khắc phục, màn hình hiển thị không cần thực hiện thêm hành động nào và nhấn [C] để tiếp tục.
Bảng Pocket Tool Table trên điều khiển hiển thị túi hiện đang ở trước trục chính và dụng cụ trong trục chính, đảm bảo công cụ trong trục chính và túi hiện tại khớp với màn hình của bộ điều khiển.
Nhấn [MDI] và nhấn [ATC/FWD] để kiểm tra lại quá trình khôi phục.

Shim washers: Shims adjust the slide for proper clearance. If the slide is adjusted too tightly against the tool, it may not lock during rotation. If adjusted too loosely, tools will rock or fall out during rotation.
Adjuster rod: Locks the slide in place during a tool change.
Jam nut: This nut tightens against the slide to prevent the adjuster rod from rotating loose.
Plunger: Locks the adjuster rod during arm motion. The adjuster rod and slide cannot release the tool when the plunger is in the extended position.

selected_workflow.title: Recover a Haas SMTC after a tool changer alarm

workflow_candidates.title: Recover a Haas SMTC after a tool changer alarm

steps.title: Recognize a tool changer alarm and press RECOVER
Check the alarm page for guidance
Restore the tool changer and start automatic recovery
If automatic recovery fails, engage manual recovery
Use the manual recovery screen to move the tool changer components
Remove the tools from the double arm one at a time
Rotate the arm to origin and raise the pocket
Verify the recovered tools and update the tool table
Escalate when recovery doesn't fix it, and maintain the tool changer to prevent faults

question: What are the steps to replace a damaged tool pocket on a Haas side-mount tool changer?

response.answer:
According to the source (not technically validated): Set your rapids down to 25% and then rotate to the damaged pocket, then press e-stop once the pocket is in position.

According to the source (not technically validated): Remove three pieces of sheet metal from the bottom of the cam box (one larger piece to the left and two smaller pieces right below the double arm) to gain access to the damaged pocket and the switches behind it, but remove four fasteners on top of the machine first before moving the larger panel.

According to the source (not technically validated): Remove all the tools from the carousel and mark their location, putting a mark on the disk and on the pocket for reinstallation.

According to the source (not technically validated): Remove the number ring and disconnect the main air to the machine.

According to the source (not technically validated): Remove the pilot check valve, which allows moving the pocket up and down freely to reach the screw.

According to the source (not technically validated): Remove the four bolts from the pocket stop to continue with the removal of the pocket.

According to the source (not technically validated): Remove the shoulder bolt on the backside of the carousel right next to the lower proximity switch, then remove the retaining bolt and remove the pocket.

According to the source (not technically validated): Before installing the new pocket, rotate the cam follower to make sure it is spinning freely, check the plungers inside the pocket to make sure they are not worn out, and apply grease in the pocket slider.

According to the source (not technically validated): Install the pocket to the slider and install both of them back in position.

According to the source (not technically validated): Reinstall the retainer bolt and tighten it.

According to the source (not technically validated): Install the shoulder bolt by lowering the pocket and attaching and screwing in the shoulder bolt.

According to the source (not technically validated): Install the pocket stop.

According to the source (not technically validated): Install the check valve.

According to the source (not technically validated): Reinstall the number disc by lining up the dot on the number disc with the dot on the pocket.

According to the source (not technically validated): Install the remaining three panels.

According to the source (not technically validated): With the panels in place, install the tools, turn on the main air, release the e-stop, and run the tool changer through several tool changes to ensure everything is working correctly.

Remove all the tools from the carousel and mark their location, putting a mark on the disk and on the pocket for reinstallation.
Remove the number ring and disconnect the main air to the machine.
Remove the pilot check valve, which allows moving the pocket up and down freely to reach the screw.
Remove the four bolts from the pocket stop to continue with the removal of the pocket.
Remove the shoulder bolt on the backside of the carousel right next to the lower proximity switch, then remove the retaining bolt and remove the pocket.

Before installing the new pocket, rotate the cam follower to make sure it is spinning freely, check the plungers inside the pocket to make sure they are not worn out, and apply grease in the pocket slider.
Install the pocket to the slider and install both of them back in position.
Reinstall the retainer bolt and tighten it.
Install the shoulder bolt by lowering the pocket and attaching and screwing in the shoulder bolt.
Install the pocket stop.
Install the check valve.
Reinstall the number disc by lining up the dot on the number disc with the dot on the pocket.
Install the remaining three panels.
With the panels in place, install the tools, turn on the main air, release the e-stop, and run the tool changer through several tool changes to ensure everything is working correctly.

Corrosion inside of cambox.
-> The output shaft seal has gone bad and coolant has gotten into the cambox. Replace corroded parts inside of cambox. Replace the output shaft seal and check for scoring on the shaft. Refill the cambox with oil.

SMTC Double Arm Replacement Verification

chunks.text:

Verify that the double arm has the correct key slot offset: casted double arm has the key slot machined at a 0 degree angle position or at a 2.5 degree angled position; both use only a straight key instead of an offset key. HSG - 7/5/2023

Cambox Exhaust Check Valve
Verify the check valve arrow is facing away from the cambox. The check valve (PN 58-2754) should be installed between the brass fitting (PN 58-1674) and muffler fitting (PN 58-1865). HSG - 7/12/2023

Cambox Proximity Sensors
Corrective Action: Remove the carousel number plate to get access to the sensors. Go into manual tool recovery and push ATC FWD to move the arm through a complete cycle. If the sensors fail to change state, refer to the Proximity Sensor - Troubleshooting Guide.

chunks.text:
- VF/VM/UMC/EC - Carousel and Pocket - Troubleshooting Guide

The cambox on a DT/DM is unable to rotate by hand.
-> The cambox will not be able to rotate by hand because it will eventually contact the rocker arm and try to unclamp the spindle. DO NOT replace the cambox because you are unable to rotate by hand; contact your local Haas Factory Outlet for further assistance.

EC/VC tool change cycle is very slow.
-> Parameter 223 Tool Changer Air Door Delay Change has a value; this should only have a value if a pneumatic door is present. Update configuration files to the latest, Parameter 223 will be set to zero. HSG-N 02-14-2023

Replacement double arm is not the correct length.
-> The incorrect double arm may have been ordered. Verify the correct part number and supersession has been ordered. Refer to the Double Arm Replacement Verification section.

Vertical Cambox's built June 15 2023 and later: Oil is leaking out of the cambox arm shaft. (Does not affect DT/DM/UMC-350 camboxes.)
-> There may be a problem with the exhaust check

Introduction
This procedure tells you how to perform a manual recovery on the Side-Mount Tool Changer (SMTC) of a Haas mill. A recovery is required if the SMTC cannot complete a tool change.

VMC - HMC - Side-Mount Tool Changer - Manual Recovery

1. Push [RESET] to clear any alarms. Push [RECOVER]. The control attempts an automatic recovery. Push [A].

2. If the automatic recovery attempt is not successful, the control gives you the (M) Manual recovery option. Push [M] for Manual.

Push [ORIENT SPINDLE] to reset the spindle orientation and lock it. Push the [LEFT] or [RIGHT] cursor arrows to turn the carousel left or right. Side-Mount Tool Changer - Manual Recovery - Mill

Introduction
This procedure tells you how to perform a manual recovery on the Side-Mount Tool Changer (SMTC) of a Haas mill. A recovery is required if the SMTC cannot complete a tool change.

VMC - HMC - Side-Mount Tool Changer - Manual Recovery

1. Push [RESET] to clear any alarms. Push [RECOVER]. The control attempts an automatic recovery. Push [A].

2. If the automatic recovery attempt is not successful, the control gives you the (M) Manual recovery option. Push [M] for Manual.

3. The display shows suggestions to correct the problem. Follow the prompts as they are displayed. Use these commands to move the tool changer components: Push [ATC FWD] or [ATC REV] to turn the double arm. Push the [UP] or [DOWN] cursor arrows to raise or lower the tool pocket. Push [ORIENT SPINDLE] to reset the spindle orientation and lock it. Push the [LEFT] or [RIGHT] cursor arrows to turn the carousel left or right. Push the [TOOL RELEASE] button to trigger the tool clamp/unclamp.

4. If you push [ORIENT

Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Trước tiên, đặt tốc độ nhanh (rapids) xuống 25% và quay đến hốc dao bị hỏng, sau đó nhấn nút dừng khẩn cấp (e-stop) khi hốc dao đã ở đúng vị trí.

Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Tháo ba tấm kim loại tấm từ đáy hộp cam (gồm một tấm lớn bên trái và hai tấm nhỏ phía dưới tay kẹp kép) để tiếp cận hốc dao hỏng và các công tắc phía sau, nhưng trước khi di chuyển tấm lớn cần tháo bốn ốc vít ở phía trên máy.

Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Lấy tất cả các dụng cụ ra khỏi băng tải (carousel), đánh dấu vị trí của chúng và đánh dấu trên đĩa cũng như trên hốc dao để lắp lại đúng cách.

Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Tháo vòng số (number ring), sau đó ngắt nguồn khí chính cấp vào máy.

Theo nguồn (chưa có xác nhận kỹ thuật): Tháo van một chiều điều khiển thí điểm (pilot check valve).

Cambox Exhaust Check Valve

chunks.text:
it. Push the [LEFT] or [RIGHT] cursor arrows to turn the carousel left or right. Push the [TOOL RELEASE] button to trigger the tool clamp/unclamp.

4. If you push [ORIENT SPINDLE], the display shows a warning dialog box. Push [N] to cancel the spindle orientation if the tool changer double arm will interfere with the spindle when the spindle orients. If the spindle can safely be rotated and locked, push [O].

5. After the problem has been corrected, the display shows that no further actions are required. Push [C] to continue.

6. The Pocket Tool Table on the control displays the pocket that is currently in front of the spindle and the tool that is in the spindle. Make sure that the tool in the spindle and the current pocket match the control's display.

Introduction
This procedure tells you how to perform a manual recovery on the Side-Mount Tool Changer (SMTC) of a Haas mill. A recovery is required if the SMTC cannot complete a tool change.

VMC - HMC - Side-Mount Tool Changer - Manual Recovery

1. Push [RESET] to clear any alarms. Push [RECOVER]. The control attempts an automatic recovery. Push [A].

2. If the automatic recovery attempt is not successful, the control gives you the (M) Manual recovery option. Push [M] for Manual.

3. The display shows suggestions to correct the problem. Follow the prompts as they are displayed. Side-Mount Tool Changer - Manual Recovery - Mill

Introduction
This procedure tells you how to perform a manual recovery on the Side-Mount Tool Changer (SMTC) of a Haas mill. A recovery is required if the SMTC cannot complete a tool change.

VMC - HMC - Side-Mount Tool Changer - Manual Recovery

1. Push [RESET] to clear any alarms. Push [RECOVER]. The control attempts an automatic recovery. Push [A].

2. If the automatic recovery attempt is not successful, the control gives you the (M) Manual recovery option. Push [M] for Manual.

3. The display shows suggestions to correct the problem. Follow the prompts as they are displayed. Use these commands to move the tool changer components: Push [ATC FWD] or [ATC REV] to turn the double arm. Push the [UP] or [DOWN] cursor arrows to raise or lower the tool pocket. Push [ORIENT SPINDLE] to reset the spindle orientation and lock it. Push the [LEFT] or [RIGHT] cursor arrows to turn the carousel left or right. Push the [TOOL RELEASE] button to trigger the tool clamp/unclamp.

Introduction
This procedure tells you how to perform a manual recovery on the Side-Mount Tool Changer (SMTC) of a Haas mill. A recovery is required if the SMTC cannot complete a tool change.

VMC - HMC - Side-Mount Tool Changer - Manual Recovery

1. Push [RESET] to clear any alarms. Push [RECOVER]. The control attempts an automatic recovery. Push [A].

2. If the automatic recovery attempt is not successful, the control gives you the (M) Manual recovery option. Push [M] for Manual.

3. The display shows suggestions to correct the problem. Follow the prompts as they are displayed. Use these commands to move the tool changer components: Push [ATC FWD] or [ATC REV] to turn the double arm. Push the [UP] or [DOWN] cursor arrows to raise or lower the tool pocket. Push [ORIENT SPINDLE] to reset the spindle orientation and lock it. Push the [LEFT] or [RIGHT] cursor arrows to turn the carousel left or right. Push the [TOOL RELEASE] button to trigger the tool clamp/unclamp.

4. If you push [ORIENT

4. If you push [ORIENT SPINDLE], the display shows a warning dialog box. Push [N] to cancel the spindle orientation if the tool changer double arm will interfere with the spindle when the spindle orients. If the spindle can safely be rotated and locked, push [O].

5. After the problem has been corrected, the display shows that no further actions are required. Push [C] to continue.

6. The Pocket Tool Table on the control displays the pocket that is currently in front of the spindle and the tool that is in the spindle. Make sure that the tool in the spindle and the current pocket match the control's display.

Shim washers: Shims adjust the slide for proper clearance. If the slide is adjusted too tightly against the tool, it may not lock during rotation. If adjusted too loosely, tools will rock or fall out during rotation.
Adjuster rod: Locks the slide in place during a tool change.
Jam nut: This nut tightens against the slide to prevent the adjuster rod from rotating loose.
Plunger: Locks the adjuster rod during arm motion. The adjuster rod and slide cannot release the tool when the plunger is in the extended position.

a feeler gauge. The correct space is between 0.014 in (0.36 mm) and 0.020 in (0.51 mm). If the machine is a DM-1 or DT-1, the correct space is between 0.005 in (0.13 mm) and 0.015 in (0.38 mm). 1. Push [RESET] to clear any alarms. Push [RECOVER]. The control attempts an automatic recovery. Push [A].

3. The display shows suggestions to correct the problem. Follow the prompts as they are displayed. Use these commands to move the tool changer components: [ATC FWD]/[ATC REV] to turn the double arm; [UP]/[DOWN] cursor arrows to raise or lower the tool pocket;

question: Sau khi khôi phục bộ thay dao, cửa sổ nào trong nguồn giúp xác định những dao vừa được lấy ra và bảng dữ liệu nào được nhắc đến tiếp theo?

response.answer:

Side-Mount Tool Changer - Manual Recovery - Mill

Introduction
This procedure tells you how to perform a manual recovery on the Side-Mount Tool Changer (SMTC) of a Haas mill. A recovery is required if the SMTC cannot complete a tool change.

VMC - HMC - Side-Mount Tool Changer - Manual Recovery

1. Push [RESET] to clear any alarms. Push [RECOVER]. The control attempts an automatic recovery. Push [A].

2. If the automatic recovery attempt is not successful, the control gives you the (M) Manual recovery option. Push [M] for Manual.

3. The display shows suggestions to correct the problem. Follow the prompts as they are displayed. Use these commands to move the tool changer components: Push [ATC FWD] or [ATC REV] to turn the double arm. Push the [UP] or [DOWN] cursor arrows to raise or lower the tool pocket.
